description: §41.13 / §19.7 — the `!{}` handler of a parseVariant call covers two of the four ParseError variants (no UnknownVariant, no InvalidPayload) and has no wildcard: E-TYPE-080.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md "⭐ RULED — S478 hand-off §3.A and §3.B, PA recs adopted (S479, 2026-11-18)" item 6 (§41.13 strict keys + E-TYPE-080; `parseVariant` accepts an enum alias)
rationale: §41.13: "the handler's exhaustiveness check (cross-ref §19.7) sees the four `ParseError` variants and a non-exhaustive handler is `E-TYPE-080`".
